observations.body: Freedom is threatened by circumcision and a severed relation. Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage. I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

payload.posture: Read Galatians 5:1–12 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states freedom is threatened by circumcision and a severed relation. Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage. I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
